Arthur recognized the hand of his vanished predecessor, who had walked into the surf one autumn night, leaving the light burning for sailors who would never know his name.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市退去了白日的喧嚣，街道空旷而清冷。路灯将微黄的光晕投射在湿润的沥青路面上，环卫工人的扫帚声划破了夜的宁静。偶有夜班出租车如幽灵般悄然滑过十字路口，远处便利店亮着孤零零的暖光，守望着这座在睡梦与苏醒边界徘徊的庞大钢铁森林。", "w03": "- Recursion is like placing two mirrors face-to-face, where you see infinite reflections of yourself inside smaller reflections.\n- In computing, it means solving a large challenge by having an action repeat itself on smaller pieces of the same problem.\n- You must always include a clear stopping rule, or base case, so the repetition knows when to finish and hand back the answer."}
